text:
People in Philadelphia are recalibrating on Denver Barkey. PHLY Sports' Charlie O'Connor asked "What if Denver Barkey is better than we thought?" after the Montreal game, and Philly Hockey Now called him the Flyers' "'Poster Child' of Doing the Small Things." The 21-year-old, a third-round pick in 2023, has 5 goals and 13 points in 22 games on about 14 and a half minutes a night. He missed one game in mid-November and picked up an assist in his return on Nov. 17.

Our numbers call the recent run earned: 8 points, 5 of them goals, in his last ten, with more chances of his own than usual (2.2 expected goals against 1.6). Philadelphia takes 53% of the five-on-five expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, 11.5 points better than without him. The finishing is running hot, though: he's shooting 24% on just 21 shots, and his top shot speed sits in the 7th percentile.

The two-way work is the durable part. Evolving-Hockey had opponents getting fewer chances with him on last season (91st percentile among forwards). Five of his points have come on the power play; watch whether that role holds.
